summary.text: Andrea Townsend, a Pacific Green Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Oregon's 5th Congressional District to Janelle Bynum.
Andrea Townsend received 2.2% of the vote to Janelle Bynum's 54.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
She was also the party's nominee for the seat in 2024, when she received 6,193 votes in the general election.
